About This Game

See it. Become it. Transform into almost any creature you encounter!

Never Wither is an Open World Survival Crafting ARPG. Here, you will embark on a journey to collect creature companions, build thriving homesteads, and cleanse the entire world.

 

From lush river valleys to windswept plateaus, from frozen ice fields to scorching volcanic wastes…

Every corner of the continent of Edda is inhabited by fantastical creatures. However, a dark corruption stemming from the World Tree has tainted them.

Embark on a journey of exploration and purification, and become the last hope for this land.

 

 

From all-devouring Oozes to Mudballs that transform into farmland; from swift Wolf Warriors to stone giants who uproot trees as weapons—

Purify these corrupted beings in the name of the World Tree.

Incarnate as your companions, utilizing their unique combat skills and abilities, defeat bosses with precise maneuvers!

 

 

Combine and fuse the abilities of different creatures to raise a powerful team of companions.

Encounter rare special individuals with unique appearances or traits.

Gear up and venture into secret realms to find relics, conquer enemies, unlock powerful spells and facilities.

 

 

Gather resources and unleash your creativity to construct grand, fully functional temples.

Your companions are vital: they will gather, transport, farm, and defend against threats. Some can even transform into unique buildings!

Manage your residents and evolve your survival camp into a thriving, prosperous home.

 

 

In Edda, you won't be alone.

You can play in singleplayer mode, or invite friends into your world and embark on a journey of survival, building, and adventure.

You can also form clans on official servers, join battles, and fight for rich territories, or set your own rules on private servers and enjoy a variety of different experiences.

If you are interested in the following games, we think you might enjoy Never Wither:

V Rising, Palworld, Windrose, Dune: Awakening, Ark: Survival Evolved, Soulmask, Valheim, Enshrouded...

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

Some images on the store page are generated using AI tools to create initial concept art, which are then manually adjusted and modified by artists. The final works combine AI-generated foundational designs with human artistic revisions.
